description: A/B clone of exp752 (full ~277M-param LUT-GPT, 16K-step recipe) with the ONLY change being the LUT layer TYPE: every FastMultiHeadLUT site (qk_lut, v_lut, out_proj, residual_lut, emb_resid_lut) replaced by HyperplaneMultiHeadLUT (learned affine hyperplane 1[<w,x>+b>0] per index bit, generalizing the fixed anchor-pair sign test). Geometry (NAP/tph per site), optimizer recipe (Lion on LUT weights, AdamW elsewhere), bf16 LUT + fp32 master Lion, grad clip 1.0, 6L/dim384/6H, 16000 steps — IDENTICAL to exp752. hyperplane_init='anchor_pairs' (w=e_p1-e_p2, b=0) reproduces exp752 bit-for-bit at step 0, so it starts identical and diverges only as the hyperplanes learn. NOTE: learned hyperplanes add ~48M trainable params (~277M -> ~325M) -> tests learned-vs-fixed front-end, NOT iso-param. New hyperplane params routed to Adam-no-wd (hyperplane_ffn recipe). exp752 reference: val_bpb 1.216174 @ 276.8M, 3.844h. Set lut_layer_type='fast' to recover exp752 verbatim.
